a.lede: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.
a.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off

b.lede: AI training and chat history will now have separate toggles in the Gemini activity settings.
b.title: Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
